property_summary: For any input, the reference contract returns true for all non-empty _tos arrays; the mutant reverts for single-element _tos, violating the invariant that transfer succeeds exactly when _tos non-empty.
change_summary: Replace 'require(_tos.length > 0);' with 'require(_tos.length > 1);' so that empty or single-element arrays revert.
